title: Hosted CI pins the scratch-repository pnpm default, selects mawk and caches only compatible downloads
steps: Run node --test --test-reporter=tap scripts/test/ci-hosted.test.mjs from an installed checkout.
The tests execute the composite action's bootstrap shell against a fixture packageManager and recording tools, and read the workflow's runner conditions, bootstrap ordering and cache inputs.
expect: The bootstrap activates the checkout's packageManager globally before asking pnpm for the store path.
Only hosted test jobs select mawk and prepare pnpm; the root frozen install follows the dsh build.
A built-dsh cache hit does not fetch the pnpm store; cold dsh and workspace stores have separate keys.
The store cache binds lockfiles, Node, architecture and dsh, carries no checkout or secrets, and has no broad restore prefix.
evidence: Hosted run 41019550735; locally reproduced Node 24.11.1/Corepack 0.34.2 MODULE_NOT_FOUND for pnpm 12 bin/pnpm.cjs and GNU awk 5.2.1 Node_array_ref crash. Full runtime verification is recorded in docs/references/gates-ci-runners.md; this case guards workflow wiring.
fence: Hosted-only bootstrap; no change to self-hosted selection, install order or test assertions

tests: only hosted test jobs select mawk and pin pnpm before installing or running tests
a hosted dsh cache hit does not download the pnpm store; cold builds use a separate store key
the hosted download cache binds both installs, Node, architecture and dsh, and caches no checkout
the hosted pnpm bootstrap activates the checkout pin globally before asking pnpm for its store
